description: geoportal.hessen.de: electricity datasets is a collection of datasets listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportal.hessen.de. Coverage: the area served by geoportal.hessen.de. The listing groups 11 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about electricity; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Regionalplan Mittelhessen WFS - hochspannung_b - OGC WFS Interface; Regionalplan Nordhessen WFS - kraftwerk_b - OGC API Features; Regionalplan Südhessen WFS - hochspannung_p - OGC WFS Interface; Regionalplan Nordhessen WFS - hochspannung_p - OGC WFS Interface. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
